about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in the captivating world of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die with this exclusive Artbook, showcasing visual wonders from early sketches to final, stunning renders.

Journey through pages brimming with mesmerizing realms, formidable foes, and the enchanting magic of Cards, Relics, and Weapons. Get up close with the vibrant cast of the Black Die—both friend and foe alike—and uncover rare insights into the whimsical and eerie world of Random.

Packed with visual treasures, including:

- Never-before-seen concept art
- Stunning evolution from early concepts to final form
- An exclusive behind-the-scenes look at the Intro Cinematic
- Rare anecdotes and secrets straight from the developers

For those who love art, storytelling, and the world of Lost in Random: The Eternal Die, this is your chance to own a piece of its creation.
